visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short, styled dark hair and a headset microphone stands in front of a large green chalkboard in a classroom. He is wearing a black T-shirt with a yellow cartoon graphic. He looks towards the side and gestures with his hands while speaking. (2) The shot shifts to a slightly closer angle of the same man in the black T-shirt. His expression becomes stern and scolding, with his eyes narrowed and mouth moving rapidly. The setting is still the brightly lit classroom with the chalkboard background. (3) A different man wearing a beige baseball cap, glasses, and a beige shirt appears in a classroom setting. He points his finger aggressively toward the camera, his facial expression filled with exaggerated indignation and lecturing intensity as he speaks. (4) The first man in the black shirt is shown again, now looking upwards with wide eyes and a dramatic, inspired facial expression. He continues to use the headset microphone. The lighting remains bright and even across the indoor school environment. (5) The scene moves outdoors to the front of a school building with banners. The man in the beige cap gestures broadly with his arms. The first man in the black shirt appears beside him, staring directly and intensely into the camera lens.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice begins speaking in a measured, lecturing tone, accompanied by an upbeat, bouncy electronic BGM. The environment sounds like a quiet indoor room. (2) The same male voice suddenly increases in volume and aggression, shouting a series of rhetorical questions. The quirky BGM persists underneath the high-intensity vocal delivery. (3) A second male voice with a higher pitch and faster speech rate takes over, sounding frantic and accusatory. The background music continues to loop with a steady beat. (4) The first male voice returns, speaking in a more theatrical and dramatic fashion with a rising pitch contour. The BGM maintains its consistent volume and pace throughout this transition. (5) The audio background shifts slightly to include subtle outdoor wind noise. The second male voice yells an instruction before a sharp, high-pitched digital stinger sound effect marks the comedic conclusion of the video.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic compilation of stereotypical phrases and 'classic lines' often used by teachers in Taiwan. It uses exaggerated acting and familiar school settings to create a relatable and nostalgic humor for the audience.
